image_prompts.purpose: Week 5 opener board for moving from garment language to figure and croquis language.
image_prompts.visual_description: One adult-oriented fashion figure or croquis wearing a clear garment such as a simple dress, with one visible detail and one obvious pose or view cue.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean fashion-sketch or polished educational illustration style with realistic adult proportions.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the garment, one detail, and the figure position easy to read at small size. Do not crowd the image with extra figures.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid runway glamour styling, logos, childlike cartoon proportions, and cluttered backgrounds.

image_prompts.purpose: Body-reference-points diagram for the main Week 5 vocabulary matching task.
image_prompts.visual_description: A neutral front-view fashion figure diagram with six visible point labels placed clearly on the body: A at the head, B at the neck, C at the shoulder, D at the waist, E at the hip, and F at the knee.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clear educational fashion-figure style with enough realism for adult learners and enough simplicity for label matching.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the figure centered and uncluttered. Emphasize clean body-point visibility over garment detail, and make each visible key A to F easy to read on mobile.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only the point keys A, B, C, D, E, and F.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid dramatic poses, crowded annotations, extra props, overlapping garments, and extra letters beyond A to F.

image_prompts.purpose: Concept board for figure, sketch, croquis, outline, silhouette, and view language.
image_prompts.visual_description: A clean concept board with six clearly separated keyed visuals: A for figure, B for croquis, C for outline, D for silhouette, E for front view, and F for side view.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a polished fashion-education illustration style that clearly separates each visual concept.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Use distinct sections or cards so the student can easily compare front versus side view and outline versus silhouette. Make the visible keys A to F part of the board design and easy to read on mobile.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only the visible concept keys A, B, C, D, E, and F.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid dense technical labels, decorative typography, too many small examples, and extra letters beyond A to F.

image_prompts.purpose: Single labeled fashion figure with explicit point keys for the Week 5 figure-labeling task.
image_prompts.visual_description: One front-view fashion figure with eight visible point labels placed clearly on the body: A at the head, B at the neck, C at the shoulder, D at the arm, E at the waist, F at the hip, G at the leg, and H at the foot.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean educational figure style with high contrast point labels and simple body lines.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Make each point key large enough for mobile reading and keep the lines from each key short and unambiguous.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only the point keys A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid extra letters, extra points, decorative arrows, and overlapping labels.

image_prompts.purpose: Shared four-figure gallery for listening, reading, writing, and speaking.
image_prompts.visual_description: A gallery with four clearly separated fashion figures labeled only as image A, image B, image C, and image D. Image A shows a standing front-view figure wearing a simple dress with short sleeves and a hem below the knee. Image B shows a relaxed side-view figure wearing a jacket and pants. Image C shows a walking figure wearing a blouse and a skirt with a long simple silhouette. Image D shows a standing figure with one hand on the hip wearing a fitted top and wide pants.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean adult-oriented fashion-sketch gallery style with strong silhouette contrast and easy visual comparison.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the four figures evenly spaced and visually distinct. The gallery must support exact answer-key matching across listening and reading tasks.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only the visible image keys A, B, C, and D.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid extra decorative text, background scenes, accessories that hide the garment, and pose ambiguity.
